STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_1.title: Endless Exploration
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_1.description:
As an advisor to the Adventurers’ Guild, Linnea has traveled throughout Teyvat, exploring wonders and hidden places that no one has reached before.

So when word came that the Spire had opened, her eyes shone brighter than ever.

“Let’s go, Lumi! A new adventure awaits!”
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_1.unlockInfo: Finish a run as the Ironclad, including abandoning a run.
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_1.unlockText: Unlock Linnea as a playable character.
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_2.title: A Bigger Bestiary!
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_2.description:
The Spire yielded more discoveries than she had imagined. Beyond its unheard-of treasures, its creatures were astonishingly diverse.

With every climb, Linnea added several pages to her natural history guide.

As for Linnea herself… she was already completely absorbed in observing its marvelous inhabitants. What wonderful news.
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_3.title: The Mysterious Ancients
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_3.description:
During her climbs, Linnea met many of the Ancients.

Some were curious, some awkward; some slumbered at the bottom, while others had lived in the Spire for ages… None of that seemed to concern her.

Fortunately, her habit of touching them never seemed to put her in danger.
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_3.unlockInfo: Defeat 3 bosses in total as Linnea.
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_4.title: An Unfriendly Welcome?
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_4.description:
At last Linnea reached the summit. Neither treasure nor fascinating creatures awaited her there.

The man who called himself the Architect simply sent her back to the foot of the Spire, again and again, without tiring.

Of course—he must be guarding the Spire’s secrets!
STS2_LINNEA_EPOCH_4.unlockInfo: Win an Ascension 1 run as Linnea.
